label: Radicalized Great Lakes ecological kinship into anti-capitalist Nishnaabeg resurgence
description: Sharing Anishinaabe/Potawatomi plant and land ethics with Kimmerer, Simpson argues that reciprocal ecological relations demand dismantling settler capitalism.
dialecticalTension: Connects botanical reciprocity to militant Indigenous political resurgence.

label: Built on Anishinaabe land defense to codify grounded normativity
description: Extending Winona LaDuke’s grassroots Anishinaabe land and seed sovereignty struggles, Simpson theorized everyday land-based Nishnaabeg ethics as political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Bridges White Earth ecological activism and Michi Saagiig Nishnaabeg theory.

label: Theorized Grounded Normativity and Kwe as Method
description: Simpson articulated grounded normativity (alongside Glen Coulthard) as ethical intelligence generated directly through land, story, and non-authoritarian Indigenous kinship.
dialecticalTension: Replaces state-centric recognition politics with land-generated Indigenous law.

label: Informed Potawatomi relational climate ethics and collective continuance
description: Whyte directly engages Simpson’s Nishnaabeg resurgence and grounded normativity to argue that climate resilience depends on Indigenous kinship and consent.
dialecticalTension: Transfers Nishnaabeg political resurgence into Indigenous climate justice.

citations.author: Kyle Powys Whyte
